solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A prisoner released with greeting inside for church member

indicators.note: the greeting is placed within the rearranged letters
a prisoner set free has his letters loosened and rearranged

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: A freed convict says hello on his way to becoming a regular churchgoer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'released' reads as the convict's freedom but scrambles A PRISONER; 'inside' places the greeting within that mix, splitting it after its fifth letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A parishioner is a person belonging to a parish church congregation.

clue.text: Plan Irene devised is never failing

indicators.note: devised suggests the letters are worked out afresh into a new order

explanation.surface: A plan thought up by a woman called Irene is foolproof.
explanation.definitionFit: Perennial means lasting or recurring endlessly, so it is constant and unfailing.

clue.text: Entertainment organiser getting wine before film

parts.note: red is a type of wine
a coat is a thin film or layer, as of paint

explanation.surface: A party planner gets a glass of wine before the movie starts.
explanation.walkthrough: A Redcoat is an entertainer at a Butlin's holiday camp, a British seaside resort chain.
explanation.definitionFit: Redcoats are the staff who run games and shows at British holiday camps.

clue.text: Best deal I arranged for furniture item

indicators.note: arranged tells us these letters are set out in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of the bargain they struck on a piece of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A side table is a small table placed against a wall or beside a chair, a piece of furniture.

clue.text: Place in ground for Italian team?

definitions.meaning: to bury a body in a grave
... Milan is a football club from Italy

explanation.definitionFit: To inter is to bury; Internazionale, known as Inter, is a Milan football club.

clue.text: Capital of three islands in North America

indicators.note: the three islands are placed inside the abbreviation for the continent

parts.note: I is the abbreviation for island, and Cos is a Greek island
Cos is an island in the Dodecanese, Greece
I abbreviates island again

explanation.surface: A question about which city is the capital of a group of islands near America.
explanation.walkthrough: The three islands are I, COS and I; they go between N and A.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicosia is the capital city of Cyprus.

clue.text: Bouquet in hearing for BBC DG

indicators.note: in hearing says the word is judged by its sound when spoken

parts.note: a wreath is an arrangement of flowers, like a bouquet

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers is presented at a hearing for the head of the BBC.
explanation.walkthrough: John Reith was the first Director-General (DG) of the BBC, Britain's public broadcaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Reith founded the BBC and was its first Director-General.

clue.text: Dispose of actor lastly in cast

indicators.note: the final letter is placed within the word meaning cast off

parts.note: to shed is to cast off, as a snake its skin

indicators.note: lastly points to the final letter of actor

explanation.surface: A director gets rid of an actor at the end of the casting process.
explanation.definitionFit: To shred papers is to tear them up and so get rid of them.

clue.text: Body once dictated to?

parts.note: a body of office staff who took down letters dictated by their bosses

explanation.definitionFit: A secretariat is an administrative body of secretaries, who traditionally took dictation.

clue.text: Busy at work?

parts.note: a busy is old British slang for a police ..., so a busy at work is one on the job

explanation.walkthrough: 'Busy' reads as an adjective, but it is British slang for a police detective.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang a 'busy' is a plain-clothes police officer, a sleuth.

clue.text: Old scheme supported by a right-winger is illustrative

indicators.note: in a down clue the first pieces stand on top of the later ones, which hold them up

parts.note: ex means former, so old
a plan is a scheme
a Tory is a British Conservative, on the political right

explanation.surface: A former plan, backed by a conservative politician, serves as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Explanatory material serves to explain or illustrate something.

clue.text: Devise trick before cold short month?

parts.note: to con is to trick or swindle
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
Oct is the short form of October

explanation.surface: Someone thinks up a scam before a chilly, brief autumn month.
explanation.definitionFit: To concoct a plan or story is to invent or make it up.

clue.text: Fruit grew in front of joint

parts.note: rose means grew or increased
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: A gardener notes how a plant grew in front of a hip joint.
explanation.definitionFit: The hip is the red fruit a wild rose bush produces after flowering.

clue.text: Remove antique Victorian bottles

indicators.note: bottles means holds inside, so the run of letters is held within these words

explanation.surface: Someone is told to clear out old Victorian glass bottles.
explanation.definitionFit: To evict tenants is to remove them from a property by law.

clue.text: Lead a number with a very revolutionary dance

parts.note: to boss is to lead or direct

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests turning round, so these letters are read backwards

explanation.surface: A dancer leads a routine with a radical, spinning twist.
explanation.definitionFit: The bossa nova is a Brazilian dance and musical style related to samba.

clue.text: Group rises before spring to begin operations

parts.note: a set is a group of things
ups are rises, as in ups and downs
to hop is to spring or jump

explanation.surface: A team gets up early in springtime before launching a business.
explanation.definitionFit: To set up shop is an idiom for starting a business or getting established.

clue.text: Exactly in America characteristic of glasses?

definitions.meaning: an American idiom meaning precisely or spot on
spectacles sit perched on the face, so that is where they are found

explanation.definitionFit: Americans say a guess is 'on the nose' when exactly right; glasses literally rest there.

clue.text: Many aimed, we're told, for growing area?

indicators.note: we're told says the words are to be heard, not read

parts.note: a lot means many and meant means aimed or intended

explanation.surface: A crowd reports what many people intended to do.
explanation.walkthrough: An allotment is a rented plot of land for growing vegetables, common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A rented garden plot used for growing produce is the British sense of this word.

clue.text: More clean-cut person of dubious loyalties

definitions.meaning: neater or tidier, the comparative of trim
someone who changes sides to suit the moment, a political opportunist

explanation.definitionFit: Trimmer is both the comparative of trim and an old term for a political turncoat.

clue.text: Rule backed in part usually

indicators.note: backed says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A rule which in part is generally followed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the run hidden in 'part usually'; 'backed' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sutra is a rule or aphorism in Sanskrit literature or Buddhist teaching.

clue.text: Good man with morning in area showing resilience

parts.note: St, saint, is the crossword good man
am means in the morning

explanation.surface: A good man who is up early around the place shows staying power.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamina is the ability to keep going, a form of endurance or resilience.

clue.text: One found in a Latin setting?

definitions.text: One found in a Latin setting?

indicators.note: the single letter is placed within the rearranged letters
setting means putting into a new order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone discovered in a Latin landscape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setting' turns A LATIN into ITALAN; 'found in' puts I after ITAL. The whole clue also defines: a person from a Latin country.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Italy is a person from the Latin heartland.

clue.text: Leaves to get in hot water in Asian area?

definitions.text: Leaves to get in hot water
definitions.meaning: tea leaves, infused in boiling water

explanation.definitionFit: Assam is a tea variety and the Indian state where it grows.

clue.text: Fool about to get explosive

parts.note: a nit is a fool, a nitwit
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: An idiot is about to blow up.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitre, potassium nitrate, is used to make gunpowder and other explosives.

clue.text: Learner in step with old student recalled part of experiment

indicators.note: the learner goes inside the word for step

parts.note: a pace is a step
L is the learner driver's plate

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so these letters are read backwards

parts.note: OB is an old boy, a former pupil

explanation.surface: A trainee keeping pace with a former pupil remembered a stage of the trial.
explanation.definitionFit: A dummy treatment given to a control group in a medical trial.

clue.text: Peer on river for sporting event

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: the Test is a river in Hampshire, England
a match is an equal, a peer

explanation.surface: A nobleman stands beside a river to watch a game.
explanation.walkthrough: A Test match is an international cricket match lasting several days.
explanation.definitionFit: A Test match is a top international match in cricket or rugby.

clue.text: White trailer carrying soldiers

indicators.note: carrying means holding inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: ivy is a trailing climbing plant
OR stands for Other Ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A white vehicle tows a trailer full of troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivory is a creamy white colour, like elephant tusk.

clue.text: Commercial arena creating ample racket

indicators.note: creating suggests making something new, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A busy trading floor makes plenty of noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A marketplace is an area or arena where buying and selling takes place.
